targets.query:

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -30s)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "contacts" and (r._field == "range_m" or r._field == "bearing" or r._field == "rel_bearing" or r._field == "spd_kn" or r._field == "hdg" or r._field == "rel_speed_kn" or r._field == "cpa_m" or r._field == "tcpa_s" or r._field == "risk" or r._field == "encounter" or r._field == "type"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.vessel == "${vessel}")
  |> last()
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "vessel", "_time"])
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["contact", "source"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.range_m)
  |> sort(columns: ["cpa_m"])
  |> sort(columns: ["risk"], desc: true)

  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
